name: Call of Water
summary: Islen Waterseer sends Horde shamans south through the Barrens to seek Brine. There, they learn what water can cleanse and heal.

sections.title: Lessons of the Tide
sections.body: Islen Waterseer teaches that water brings rebirth. Its flow can carve rock, wash away impurities, and mend flesh, but its healing depends on purity. Polluted water brings blight instead of life. Every shaman must understand this balance before seeking communion with water.

sections.title: A Recluse in the Dust
sections.body: You travel far south through the arid Barrens to find Brine. Quilboar raids trouble the wastes, yet Brine lives alone without guards or fear. She holds the knowledge and trials that help you bind yourself to water.

faq.answer: Islen Waterseer is a shaman master on the Barrens coast, south of the Merchant Coast. She guides Horde shamans through the trials of communion with water spirits.

faq.q: Why live in the southern Barrens surrounded by quilboar?
faq.answer: Brine lives alone in the southern wastes despite constant quilboar harassment. She knows the danger seems foolish to outsiders, but keeps her reasons private and tests whether you have the fortitude to find her.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the water sapta?
faq.answer: A sapta is a ceremonial mixture that changes a shaman’s perception, letting them see and speak with elemental spirits invisible to mortal eyes.

faq.q: What core lesson does water represent to a shaman?
faq.answer: Water brings rebirth, cleansing, and renewal. Pure water can heal, but tainted or stagnant water brings decay and devastation.

aliases: is call of water horde only
faq.answer: Horde shamans who have proved their dedication and attuned to earth and fire are sent to undertake the Call of Water trials.

faq.q: What threats lie on the path to Brine?
faq.answer: The southern Barrens are dangerous, with aggressive quilboar tribes defending thorned dens and beasts hunting wanderers far from the safety of Crossroads or Camp Taurajo.

angles.text: As a shaman, communion with water marks a key step in your growth. It joins the strength of earth and the force of fire with water’s healing power.
As a member of the Horde, you travel across Kalimdor to master the elements and honor the spirits that grant the Warchief’s shamans their vital magic.
